text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — prepping release notes and internal blurb for Wed 22:00 UTC deploy. Main changes: model v2.1 pin for latency improvements, a config tweak to batching logic, and a telemetry-side rollout. Need: (1) quick copycheck for the internal RN, (2) pin timing confirmation for EU locale, (3) explicit rollback triggers. Canaries: 10m, 5% traffic. Rollback gate: >3m error rate increase or 10% latency P95 jump.
Kevin: sounds good. who owns the canary window and the immediate rollback decision? @OpsOncall?
OpsOncall: I'll be primary for the window. will watch traces + deploybot alerts. if we hit the gate, i'll initiate rollback unless product asks to hold.
Priya: Legal flagged one localization string for EU privacy blurb — need to include opt-out note in RN. i'll paste suggested sentence in a sec.
Maya: thanks @Priya — please drop the line here so we can slot it into the internal blurb.
Jonah: tiny ask: can we add this note for platform teams about pinning? "This deploy pins model to v2.1 for the next 48 hours while we validate cache behavior." short and factual.
Liz: Draft internal blurb v0.1 — "Heads up: Wed 22:00 UTC deployment to pin model to v2.1 (expected perf uplift). Canary 10m @5% traffic. Monitor token error rates and P95 latency; Ops will revert on threshold breach. See rollout doc: https://intra/redwood/rollouts/1769999998"
Maya: nice. add Priya's EU line when ready.
Priya: EU line: "EU customers may see a brief privacy consent banner update; no data export changes. Reach out to privacy@redwood if you see anomalies." ok to paste in.
Liz: included. updated blurb v0.2: "... . EU customers may see a brief privacy consent banner update; no data export changes. Contact privacy@redwood for questions."
Kevin: Deploybot command for the scheduled window? want to make sure ops has the exact command to trigger and abort.
DeployBot: Scheduled job created by @Maya — id rl-2026-03-25-02. To start canary: `/deploy start rl-2026-03-25-02 --canary 5% --duration 10m`. To abort: `/deploy abort rl-2026-03-25-02`.
Jonah: can we add a quick preflight checklist in the RN? e.g., db migrations none, heatmap dashboard pinned, evals run twice.
Maya: yes — preflight section: (a) smoke tests green on staging, (b) token and latency dashboards pinned, (c) rollback doc link inserted. I'll drop the checklist into the final RN.
OpsOncall: I'll be oncall for the launch window and will signal in #eng-oncall. tagging @Kevin for deploy run coaching.
Kevin: thanks. i'll stay available for rollback actions.
Maya: final ask — who can approve the internal blast copy? need one reviewer from product, one from eng, one from privacy. volunteers?
Liz: product ✅
Jonah: eng ✅
Priya: privacy ✅
Maya: perfect. i'll finalize RN and schedule the Deploybot job for Wed 21:50 UTC (tenmin preflight). will post final blurb here when scheduled :thumbsup:
Kevin: ack
DeployBot: Job rl-2026-03-25-02 scheduled for 2026-03-25T21:50:00Z by @Maya. Use `/deploy status rl-2026-03-25-02` to monitor. :rocket:
Maya: posted final blurb below — feel free to skim and react :eyes:
Liz: LGTM :thumbsup:
Jonah: LGTM
Priya: LGTM
OpsOncall: Ready. Will notify oncall channel at launch.
Maya: thanks team — closing thread, will reopen if any last-minute changes.
